tone.target: bright jangly clean pop-rock with slight edge
tone.profile: bright jangly clean pop-rock with slight edge
tone.summary: A bright signal chain using light compression, a Chorus effect for width, followed by the US Deluxe amp model with a clear Fender/Vox character, paired with the US 2x12 cabinet to achieve a sparkling, articulate jangly clean pop-rock sound.
